description:
The Process of Turning Discarded Cola into a Stylish Bag

Hello, this is King Process.
Can a discarded Coca-Cola shopping bag become a stylish handbag? In this video, we visit a Korean workshop where Coca-Cola shopping bags and other discarded materials are turned into new bags.
Materials we would normally throw away take on a different form in the hands of a skilled artisan. Keeping the original logos and patterns, the artisan carefully works each piece by hand to create a finished bag.
Watch along to see what an ordinary Coca-Cola shopping bag becomes and how it is made.
If you enjoyed the video, please like and subscribe. Let us know in the comments which bag you liked best!

1. A $0 Cola Gift Bag Becomes a $2,000 Luxury Bag. A Korean Workshop Artisan

2. The process of trash materials becoming a high-end handbag. A Korean workshop artisan

3. The process by which crocodiles from the Nile River are made into high-end luxury wallets. Korea's Best Leather Craftsman
